name: Steam Mine
primary:
A steam mine that bursts when an enemy comes close.
A mine at the aim point for 30 s: arms in 1 s and explodes in a 2.5-block radius when an enemy comes near:
• Damage 1 ❤ fire + 1 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 8.8 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
• Blindness for 2.75 s
self_description:

• Damage 1 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 8.8 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
